comparators.diversity: Use the first admissible representative in each early bin. The bin uses sign(b2-b1), number of parent-count bands 1, 2, 3+, presence of 3+, and state as observed at the second cut, with missing entries preserved. When the archive is empty draw independently. Otherwise restart independently with probability 1/4 or pick uniformly among occupied bins and edit one token. Choose among a Prüfer-coordinate replacement, optional missing-meeting token replacement, or spare bit flip with equal probability. The optional token may be None. The edited candidate then faces the same charged admission.
comparators.equal_count_sensitivity: For each paired repeat clip both logs to the smaller number of fully completed raw proposals, including charged refusals or duplicates with a known result. Redo witness selection and checking on both clipped logs with a fresh 50 ms CPU allowance each. Record those costs separately.
comparators.independent: Independent proposals from the same source weighting after the common first proposal. Proposals never consult history. Shared admission still identifies duplicate canonical sources.

decision_rules.failures: Retain counts, raw failures, resource charges, partial or censored rows and mismatching literal replays. A semantic mismatch makes the affected experiment readout incomplete until resolved. Do not substitute an unverified candidate.
decision_rules.fresh_feature: Every unordered distinct matched pair qualifies once with proposal mass proportional to the product of source masses. Conditioning is on remaining after exclusions, equality of (n,b1,b2), and both b3 fully observed. Rate concordance only where both predicted and actual differences are nonzero. Report tie/abstain coverage and any cap independently of concordance.
decision_rules.search: 48 reset independent paired repeats per law. Report raw paired counts, means, W/T/L, any-discovery and any-difference Clopper-Pearson 95% intervals, exact two-sided non-tie sign tests with Holm across the two laws, and a 10,000-resample deterministic descriptive bootstrap CI of paired mean difference. Report zero events and all ties explicitly. Significance at Holm p<0.05 is directional only within a tested law, source weighting and budget.

development_disclosures: The initial prefreeze 2048-proposal safety limit stopped 9 of 20 diversity arms and 0 of 20 independent arms on the development partition. Before any search or fresh outputs were examined, the limit was raised for both arms to 16384. Time, growth, evidence and scoring thresholds were kept. At the raised ceiling all 40 development arms reached the CPU boundary, with zero compact/literal disagreements. Both runs are retained.
forbidden_inputs: Evaluated validation-bucket outcomes or fits before the search has completed.
Calibration membership, late profiles, collision results, literal replay outcomes, or reserve information in proposal selection.
Cross-arm result, certificate, replay or archive caches. Only immutable truth tables and common reference data are shared.
Treating a source or its renaming as two discoveries.

growth_interface.known_closure_relay: Within a connected source the first NAE round with one birth identifies a parity closing top before the laws can have diverged. Treat such NAE candidates as known whole-closure continuations and give them zero primary novelty credit. Report the flag descriptively.
growth_interface.limits: 192 births in each round, with a bounded 1024-group lookahead and a 32768 witness-pair entry cap before constructing its candidate pairs. Record stall, closure, horizon and each cap separately. Use the compact operator only within these limits. Match limited eligibility for both arms.
growth_interface.stage_observations: Exact introduced-knot count, total loose distinctions, live-knot count, and joint histogram of parent number and fresh-distinction count for each complete round. No padding after a stall, closure or incomplete round.

nonclaims: Empirical, bounded discovery yield over this supplied weighting, cohort, rules and workload. It is not a theorem about all growth, a proof of continued growth, physical time, a distance or a computational complexity result.
Reference absence is defined only relative to the frozen dictionary. No external mathematical novelty or general advantage of adaptive search is assessed.

The proposal mutations edit initial source descriptions and certify their intended laws afresh. They are not additional moves in the ordinary growth rule and do not preserve the previous start's entire allowed-state relation.
primary_observable: Count of reference-absent late types with two different canonical founders in one repeat, both independently replayed within the verification allowance. For a still-growing five-round record the late type is (sign(b3-b2), sign(b4-b3), sign(b5-b4), any unary birth in 3-5, any birth with 3+ parents in 3-5). Closed, stalled, capped, invalid or incomplete records cannot count as new late types.

public_inputs.canonical_split: Encode n, loose counts and the minimum binary incidence masked over all orders within sorted (degree, loose count) classes. Any renaming induces identical candidate orderings and vice versa. SHA-256 as a big-endian integer modulo five uses a frozen namespace. Residue 0 is development, 1-3 search and 4 validation. Refused out-of-partition codes and genotypes are omitted from persisted search records. Count all refusals and charge their costs.
public_inputs.common_information: Both proposal policies have the same generator, lawfulness checks, ordinary growth, public early readings and candidate scoring. For the first raw proposal in each paired repeat use one shared genotype. Thereafter use independently seeded streams, resetting every arm and repeat. Randomize arm execution order by a fixed separate seed.
public_inputs.dependency: ORDINARY-DYNAMICS A supplies compact ordinary growth. NAE-GROWTH B supplies independent literal holdings for each scored witness. GENERATORS A supplies exact projections for admissibility.
public_inputs.reference: Exactly 128 lawful independent with-replacement draws in the development bucket, after the fixed public-control exclusions, with frozen RNG key development/calibration-fixed. Grow them under both laws and use the union within each law of their still-growing late profiles and exact public control profiles from ORDINARY-DYNAMICS and GENERATORS. Freeze and hash the raw calibration, roster, and code. Exact public reference identities that lie in the proposal family are removed from all experiment partitions.
public_inputs.source_admission: Require all founder supports, including spent founders, to project to exactly the intended even parity and unsigned not-all-equal words in the complete source under the respective laws. Check both laws on each admissible source before either law's growth. Repeat the check on every edited admitted source. Refuse raw extra tokens absorbed by a changed tree, out-of-partition sources, three exact public reference identities, and exact duplicates within an arm. Charge all such proposals. Duplicates supply no extra witnesses.
public_inputs.source_weighting: Sample n uniformly from 4, 5, 6. Sample a labeled tree by n-2 independent uniform Prüfer labels. With probability one-half add one uniformly chosen missing meeting. For each founder use max(0, 3-degree) loose distinctions plus an independent fair spare bit. A meeting shares one distinction between two holders.

question: At matched CPU allowances, do independent sources or diversity-seeking one-token edits find more independently replayed late signatures outside a common reference dictionary over five ordinary rounds?

resource_budget.ceiling: 16384 raw proposals per arm. Four worker processes with at most 384 MiB per case and an aggregate 4 GiB cap. 10 seconds wall per case and no retry. The separate validation census is one bounded shared-runner case. Scientific work uses the virtual environment and writes only fresh result directories.
resource_budget.per_arm: 80,000,000 process CPU ns for proposal creation, serial admission, growth, early readings/archive, and per-trial scoring readouts. 50,000,000 separate process CPU ns for candidate selection and literal replay in chronological-primary, primary-minimum, then collision order. The count sensitivity reuses the fixed raw prefix with identical fresh 50 ms verification, with no adaptive feedback.
resource_budget.per_attempt: Record process CPU and wall time of each raw attempt including rejects/duplicates. Record both phases' actual, allowance, unspent, and overshoot, and mark a completed or interrupted attempt beyond a CPU boundary as ineligible. SIGPROF is a backstop. Record shared start creation, import, warmup, runner time and memory separately.
resource_budget.reproducibility: Exact seeds are SHA-256 of fixed experiment namespace and explicit per-phase/arm/role keys in source. Proposal and replay behavior is deterministic at a given chronological prefix. Hardware usage and the count of trials fitting real CPU windows can vary on replay.

secondary_observable.collision: Distinct canonical founders agree on (founder count, b1, b2) and differ in fully observed b3. Prioritize verification of new late types. Replay the earliest and smallest observed eligible collision pairs if reserve remains.
secondary_observable.fresh_feature: Once both laws' search repeats complete, assess the sign of H2 from total loose distinctions after round two as a predictor for the sign of the b3 difference in matched distinct reserved founders. Exact atlas census plus every decoration generation gives all canonical source IDs and exact probability mass. Grow only in the fresh reserve after public reference exclusions. Independently replay every fully observed b3. Report unweighted and proposal-weighted matched shares, concordant/reverse pairs, one/both tied, and accuracy among decisive differences against 1/2. Include accuracy at half credit for abstentions, their coverage among unequal b3, and four deterministic hash-paired no-reuse sensitivities. This finite census needs no iid pair interval.
secondary_observable.sample_minimum: For the smallest observed literal witness independently rank pairs by (max founders, sum founders, max physical distinctions, sum physical distinctions, sorted exact founder codes). Report separately for primary and collision and only as a finite sample minimum.

stop_rule: Stop each arm at the first CPU or proposal boundary. Stop search after 48 paired repeats per law. Stop the fresh validation at exhaustion of the one reserved census. Seal results only after the coordinating task confirms scored Stage A and an independent R1 report binding this contract. Fresh validation also requires a complete search summary of the same frozen inputs.
